commit.message: fix(control): keep snapshots out of store census

intent: Rename the private Mission Control SQLite evidence snapshot so a transient copy no longer masquerades as a new durable store in the repository's lexical inventory. Preserve exact WAL visibility, query-only behavior, source-file immutability, the committed 39-store baseline, and every P1 atomic-evidence file. This packet changes no schema, database location, authority, provider, task lifecycle, repository effect, or terminal projection.

negative_controls.command: python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_mission_control_a2a.py -k "held_open_wal_job_is_visible or projection_preserves_exact_source_file_set_and_bytes or absent_databases_fail_without_creating_files or absent_taskboard_is_not_created"
negative_controls.name: snapshot-remains-wal-exact-read-only-and-noncreating

honest_blockers: This packet only corrects the name of an isolated read snapshot. It does not add a semantic producer, run Foundry, produce an independent Vibe Halt verdict, authorize or apply a repository effect, transition a Mission Control task, or claim an end-to-end run.

The store inventory is lexical rather than a live writer trace. Passing it proves the transient filename no longer claims a durable store suffix; it does not prove the absence of every dynamically resolved store.
PR 1466 and this packet require approval before merge. Passing local or CI gates does not satisfy that external human gate.
interface_mismatches: The temporary snapshot literal evidence.sqlite3 is counted by the durable-store lexical census even though the file lives only inside a per-call TemporaryDirectory.

SQLite does not require a database suffix and appends -wal/-shm to the complete filename, so evidence.snapshot preserves the existing snapshot and recovery contract without presenting a durable-store suffix.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the P0C commit as one unit. This restores the evidence.sqlite3 temporary filename and its known 40th lexical-store CI failure; no durable database, schema, runtime receipt, service, task, provider, or external system is changed by this packet.
